item_as_listed: IPG LASER YLR-400-SM-EOS SINGLE-MODE FIBER LASER 400W M6860
condition: Used; seller: 'USED - GOOD CONDITION', 'Unit in mint condition', 'All warranty seals are in place'
extra_note: LTL freight, estimate (not quoted): 100 lb crate, 26 x 30 x 16 in., El Paso TX to Provo UT
returns_warranty: 30-day returns, seller pays return shipping; or Best Offer
checks_and_risks: 400 W single-mode, inside the 300-500 W band. Cooling, hours and fibre termination not stated.
